scope: One coherent original wind-abraded rock with broad wind-faceted faces meeting along sharp abrasion ridges. These diagnostic faces must be larger than incidental low-poly tessellation and remain readable in clay and silhouette views. No named locality, period, precise dimension or paint-only erosion features.
source_access: Original source verification labels remain unchanged. No new source browsing or factual PASS occurred during reservation.
immutable: Do not change original inventory object or broaden representation/taxon/facets. Any concept-specific decisions belong in a new derived brief after inspection.
